- You speak English or Dutch

What will you do
As a logistics associate, you’ll be responsible for sorting. This company sorts all the merchandise for a well-known retail chain—from clothing to jewelry and from suitcases to kitchen accessories. This means they no longer have to sort the items in the store. The pallets with crates are delivered to you. You’ll open each crate and then sort all the products. It’s your job to sort them by product group into separate crates. Shirts with the shirts and bags with the bags. You’ll use the barcode to determine which crate each item belongs in. That’s how you’ll sort all the products. In addition, you’ll attach security tags to the more expensive items and apply labels to some products. - Sort all the items by product group
